subject: Audit window alignment — evidence escrow rotation & retention plan
messages:
From: Oliver Barrett <oliver@rivermark.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rivermark Security <security@rivermark.com>, Procurement <procure@rivermark.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 re-attest: evidence rotation & short-term archival for renewal

Hi Mateo / Kimberly —

Quick background: Rivermark is starting our renewal cycle for Q4 and our InfoSec team needs clarity on how Redwood plans to provide rolling evidence for the attestation window. Two asks from our side: (1) an evidence rotation schedule (how you will stage and hand off artifacts to our escrow/archive during the audit window), and (2) a short-term archival/retention path for logs (we need 90 days of high-fidelity logs plus a 12-month reduced-resolution archive).

We also need to confirm whether Redwood can support a short burst of log exports (approx 500–800 GB) during the two-week deep-dive window — we want to avoid throttling that would prevent our auditors from having complete snapshots.

Can you provide a proposed schedule and tell us which artifacts will be delivered vs. escrowed (evidence index, SIEM exports, config snapshots, SOC2 binder)? Ideally we get this by EOD Monday so we can lock resources on our side.

Thanks,
Oliver Barrett
Head of Security Ops
Rivermark Payments
oliver@rivermark.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: (we can send an initial evidence checklist if helpful)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest: evidence rotation & short-term archival for renewal

Oliver — thanks for the clear ask. We can accommodate the evidence rotation and the 90-day/high-fidelity + 12-month reduced-resolution retention you described. High-level proposal below; I'll follow up with a timeline and the S3 manifest by EOD Monday.

Proposed approach (summary):
- Evidence staging: We will produce an evidence-index.csv that enumerates artifacts (config snapshots, change logs, access reports, auditor-facing playbooks). "Delivery" items (SOC 2 binder, control narrative, attestation statements) will be bundled as PDF and delivered via DocuSign link + Drive. "Escrowed" items (raw SIEM exports, full KVS traces) will be placed in a time-limited S3 escrow bucket with a signed manifest and MD5 checksums.
- Rotation cadence: nightly incremental exports during the 30-day window before the audit, daily full snapshots during the two-week deep dive, and a final immutable snapshot at the close of the audit window.
- Burst export: we can provision a short-term export job to hit ~800 GB/day for two weeks; we will route via our dedicated export pool to avoid throttling. There is a small one-time surcharge for the burst (I'll include numbers in the follow-up).
- Access model: auditors can be granted read-only, time-limited credentials to the escrow S3 (pre-signed URLs) or we can provide a zipped evidence bundle via Drive if requested.

Action items I will deliver by Monday EOD:
1) evidence-index.csv (attachment) — catalog + artifact owners
2) s3-archive-manifest.json (attachment) — bucket layout, retention tags, MD5s
3) proposed export schedule (CSV) and a short cost note for burst exports
4) DocuSign envelope for renewal terms (if procurement needs it)

If that plan looks OK, Kimberly will lead on contractual amendments for the retention addendum and Marissa will coordinate the operational runbook with your security team.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest: evidence rotation & short-term archival for renewal

Looping in technical details for the plan above — sending this to Oliver after alignment with Mateo/Kimberly. Key constraints and notes:

- Export tooling: We will use our evidence-export service that snapshots the following: audit logs (auth/iam events), network egress metrics, model-serving change events, and infra control-plane events. For SIEM exports we will provide raw logs in gzipped JSONL.
- Retention policy enforcement: S3 lifecycle rules will apply — immediate 90-day retention in standard storage (fast retrieval), 12-month archival in infrequent-access with preservation tags to prevent accidental purge during the attestation. After 12 months objects move to a cold archive for longer-term retention per contract.
- Immutable snapshot: we will generate an immutable, time-stamped archive with write-once object markers and an exported manifest signed by our key. That manifest will be part of the evidence-index.csv.
- Throughput: to meet the 500–800 GB/day export, we need to temporarily increase our export pool to 10 workers and bump network egress QoS for the two-week window. This is operationally simple — just need procurement approval for the burst fee and a date range.

I'll also attach a sample s3-archive-manifest.json (in the folder Mateo will send) with the exact keys and checksum fields.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest: evidence rotation & short-term archival for renewal

Hi Oliver — thanks for the patience. Confirming Redwood can execute the plan Mateo outlined. Next steps and asks from your side:

1) Confirm audit window dates (we recommend a two-week deep-dive starting 2028-09-11 with a 30-day ramp prior).
2) Please acknowledge the 500–800 GB/day burst export requirement so we can schedule the export pool and set the billing adjustment (we will provide a one-line pricing addendum).
3) Provide a list of auditor contact emails (we will issue read-only pre-signed URLs scoped to those addresses).

Deliverables we attached/linked to this thread: evidence-index.csv (index and owners), s3-archive-manifest.json (bucket layout + checksums), and a draft DocuSign link with the retention addendum (DocuSign envelope attached: docsign-renewal-terms.pdf). The drive folder with the initial artifacts is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcRivermarkEvidence

If we get confirmation by EOD Tuesday we will lock the export pool and send the billing addendum for Procurement to review. Marissa will be the operational point during the deep-dive and will arrange a 30-minute kick-off with your security ops the week before the audit window.
